menu_options.link: Add Bluetooth or other signals to a device

settings.title: WiFi Presence devices
settings.description: Pick the devices to track. WiFi devices and Bluetooth devices are both listed. A device that only shows up over Bluetooth works fine on its own. To use WiFi and Bluetooth together for one device, track its WiFi entry, save, then use 'Add Bluetooth or other signals to a device'. Don't see one? Wait a minute and reopen this, or add it by address below.
